title: Geometry of the printable models
coordinateSystem: Centered RAS millimeters, unchanged from the printable meshes

brain.volumeMeaning: Closed printable brain envelope, including filled internal spaces; not a measured tissue volume.

head.volumeMeaning: Closed captured outer-head/scalp model, including face, interior spaces and the capped lower field of view; not total head or skull volume.

headContours.coordinateOrder: outline points [X,Y] in model millimeters; +X toward right, +Y toward anterior
headContours.selection: 25 evenly spaced levels from 60% through 95% of the captured model height; this is a geometric band, not a detected anatomical landmark.
headContours.defaultSelection: Fixed midpoint of the upper band (77.5% of captured height), for a broad contour above facial features; not chosen to maximize area or roundness.
headContours.circlePlacement: The equal-area circle is centered at the full contour area centroid.

definitions.dimensionsMm: Axis-aligned extents: maxX-minX (right-left), maxY-minY (anterior-posterior), maxZ-minZ (captured height). These depend on pose and field-of-view coverage.
definitions.enclosedModelVolumeMl: Signed volume inside the consistently wound, closed printable surface divided by 1,000 mm³/mL. Filled internal spaces are included.
definitions.ratios: Geometric extent ratios AP/width and captured height/width. These are not clinical head indices.
definitions.equivalentVolumeSphereDiameterMm: Diameter of a mathematical sphere with the same enclosed model volume: (6V/π)^(1/3), with V in mm³.
definitions.areaMm2: Planar area enclosed by the largest closed horizontal section outline. No skull or tissue layers are separated.
definitions.perimeterMm: Length of that full, unsimplified closed section outline.
definitions.minimumAreaRectangle: The smallest-area rotated rectangle enclosing the full section outline; length is its longer side and width its shorter side.
definitions.elongation: Longer side divided by shorter side of the minimum-area rectangle; 1 means equal enclosing dimensions. It is independent of in-plane display rotation.
definitions.equalAreaCircle: Radius √(A/π), diameter 2√(A/π), circumference 2√(πA), where A is the full section area.
definitions.perimeterToEqualAreaCircleRatio: Outline perimeter divided by the circumference of a circle enclosing the same area. A mathematical circle is 1; larger values mean more perimeter for that area.

limitations: These are accurate calculations on generated meshes, not validated clinical measurements of anatomy.
The source anatomical acquisitions are 2D, with 5 mm slice thickness and approximately 6.5 mm centers. Interpolation, thresholding, hole filling and smoothing affect the surfaces.
Brain model volume includes filled internal spaces and is not brain-tissue volume. The model does not resolve a validated cortical surface.
The head is captured outer soft tissue, including facial anatomy and a closed crop boundary. Its full bounds and enclosed volume are not whole-head or skull measurements.
Horizontal contours describe the outer model outline at a chosen level; they are not skull sections or a clinical cephalic index.
The upper contour band and default level are fixed geometric choices. Different levels have different shapes; no population percentile or normality assessment is inferred.
SVG outlines use a maximum simplification tolerance of 0.2 mm; the reported metrics use unsimplified mesh sections.

withheldMetrics.corticalSurfaceArea: No validated cortical reconstruction is available.
withheldMetrics.grayWhiteMatterRatio: The Brain2Print tissue estimates are incomplete and are not suitable for a reliable quantitative tissue ratio.
withheldMetrics.populationPercentiles: No matched, validated anatomical measurement or reference population is used.
withheldMetrics.clinicalCephalicIndex: Captured scalp/face contours and model bounds do not establish this clinical measurement.

analyticShapes.ellipsePerimeterReference: 4a E(1-b²/a²), complete elliptic integral of the second kind
